intervention.rule: Keep the production 0.20 regret trigger for every rewind. Also admit regret at least 0.15 only when the exact causal sibling is at most seven gaps behind the current prefix.

design_basis.interpretation: The failed arm spent most of its added work on long rewinds that usually returned to the current prefix. The shallow subset retains about 12% of that measured work and has a materially higher alternative-selection rate. This is action-set evidence only; live traversal must be measured.

predeclared_screen.decision: Advance to a larger fresh-seed paired screen only if there are no lost completions, the full-catalog score sum is positive, and movement is not a single adverse/beneficial outlier. No canonical evaluation is authorized by this two-seed screen.
